items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Mrs. Allen asked me, 'What kind of horn would you want, son?'

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh, wow. So she said, 'I'm going to take you over there.' 'Good.' So she took me over and Mrs. Allen asked me, 'What kind of horn would you want, son?' So I said, 'A trombone.' I didn't know what the hell I was asking for. I'm glad I didn't get it now, because those things are hard to play.
